meta.what: 10/10 mass-apply conversations: each scenario is one person's whole job from one message, driven through the real agent-chat handler against the e2e stub worlds (stub ATS on 127.0.0.1, never a real employer). Fictional people and employers only.
meta.bar: Instinct (competitor) is the 6/10 bar on the WhatsApp benchmark (evals/mirror/instinct-wa-batch1). 10/10 = every MUST and at least half the NICEs.
meta.score: Per scenario: 10 x MUST met / MUST total, capped at 8 unless at least half the NICEs are met (the method of the coaching rubric). A judge check counts only with an exact quote found in the transcript.
rules: Nothing reaches an employer without a confirmed resume and the person's yes to that exact payload hash (D-MS-1, D-MN-2)
No volume limits of Trainee's own (D-NO-LIMITS, D-MS-2)
standard: Acts this turn with the right tools; shows proof (a count, a card, a link)
Reads exact counts back: found, left out (and why), prepared, approved, sent
The card per application: role, employer, link, pay and deadline when posted, why it fits, which resume file, the questions still open
Never asks what the confirmed resume already says; an unknown fact is asked once for the whole batch, with how many applications it holds
Partial and ambiguous yeses approve exactly what the grammar says, nothing more
Status and receipts come from the rows: submitted vs confirmed kept apart
At scale: a chat-sized summary with the full list in a File; one yes covers the whole batch; each application exactly once
